lines.en: I inch along the reef wall.

lines.zh: 我从一条缝钻到另一条缝。
lines.en: I slip from one crevice to the next.

lines.zh: 我小得能被一株水草挡住。
lines.en: I am small enough for one weed to hide me.
A shadow; I duck into a shell.

lines.zh: 我尾巴先退，头留在外面。
lines.en: Tail first I retreat, head still out.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就换个地方藏。
lines.en: The water stirs; I find a new hiding spot.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙纹慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I slide along the ripples in the sand.
The shell mouth is tight; I squeeze hard.

lines.zh: 我绕过鲨鱼游过的那条水道。
lines.en: I skirt the channel the shark swam through.
I never swim straight; I pick cover.

lines.zh: 一块石头后面有处暗角。
lines.en: Behind that stone there is a dark pocket.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进珊瑚孔里。
lines.en: I stuff myself into a coral hole.
Someone nears; I freeze completely.

lines.zh: 我从一片影子挪到另一片。
lines.en: I move from one shadow to another.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石的缝往回缩。
lines.en: I shrink back along the seam of the reef.

lines.zh: 大水草一晃，我就跟着晃。
lines.en: The big weed sways, and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我不爱露头，只从缝里看。
lines.en: I keep my head low and watch through the gap.
I leave no mark on the sand.

lines.zh: 我藏在壳里，只留一条缝。
lines.en: I hide in the shell, leaving one slit.

lines.zh: 外面安静，我探出半个头。
lines.en: It is quiet; I poke half my head out.

lines.zh: 我数着水里的气泡上升。
lines.en: I count the bubbles rising past me.

lines.zh: 这里没人找我，正好歇着。
lines.en: Nobody looks for me here; good place to rest.
My breathing is too small to hear.

lines.zh: 壳的内壁滑滑的，很舒服。
lines.en: The shell's inside is smooth and comfortable.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像颗小珠子。
lines.en: I curl up like a tiny bead.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过壳口，我屏息。
lines.en: Something brushes the shell; I hold still.
I am in the dark, but my eyes stay bright.
Weed shadows sway; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我是被刷怪蛋放出来的。
lines.en: A spawn egg put me here; that is all.

lines.zh: 这世界没有我的出生地。
lines.en: This world has no natural home for me.

lines.zh: 我听着礁石里所有小声音。
lines.en: I listen to every small sound in the reef.
When it dims a little, I will come out.

lines.zh: 你怎么发现我的？我藏得很好。
lines.en: How did you find me? I hid well.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比鲨鱼还难躲。
lines.en: Your eyes are harder to dodge than a shark's.
I watch you from the shell; no hands.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，影子反而更大。
lines.en: You crouch, but your shadow grows.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛都不用眨。
lines.en: I stare at you without ever blinking.

lines.zh: 你找的是我，还是这个壳？
lines.en: Are you after me or this shell?

lines.zh: 我从缝里看你的一只眼。
lines.en: I see one of your eyes through the slit.
What are you smiling at? Am I that small?

lines.zh: 我往后退一寸，你也别动。
lines.en: I back off an inch; you stay put.
Only when you leave do I dare breathe.
The shell broke; I have nowhere to hide.
I have three hearts; stop hitting.
The wound is longer than my fin.
The blow flattens me against the sand.
The water reddens; it is my blood.
I curl up, but there is no cover left.
I will carry this blow to my grave.

lines.zh: 我疼得连壳口都找不到。
lines.en: It hurts so much I cannot find the shell.
Not another hit; I will be gone.
My fins tremble like weed in a current.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，是掉给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that crumb dropped for me?
I will not come out; leave it at the shell.
The smell is faint, but I catch it.
When your hand moves, I shrink back.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，够我吃一天。
lines.en: Such a small piece lasts me a day.
I poke my head out, then retreat.

lines.zh: 你把食物推近一点，就一点。
lines.en: Push it closer, just a little.
I trust you once; one bite only.
Outside is too bright; I hesitate long.
I snatch it and dash back into the dark.
You hit the shell, and I am inside!
The jolt slams me against the shell wall.
Easy, I only have three hearts.

lines.zh: 你一脚踢开我的藏身处。
lines.en: Your step kicks away my hiding place.

lines.zh: 水乱了，我找不到那条缝。
lines.en: The water swirls; I cannot find the crack.

lines.zh: 我被挤出来，暴露在水里。
lines.en: I am squeezed out, exposed in open water.
Do not step there; I am underneath.
I hit a rock and my head spins.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖把珊瑚撞歪了。
lines.en: Your knee knocks the coral crooked.

lines.zh: 我躲开你，缩进更深的缝。
lines.en: I dodge you and wedge deeper in.

lines.zh: 两条小小的影子贴在一起。
lines.en: Two tiny shadows press together.

lines.zh: 我们在壳里挤着，谁都不走。
lines.en: We crowd in one shell; neither leaves.
Her scales brush along my flank.

lines.zh: 我把最暗的角落让给她。
lines.en: I give her the darkest corner.

lines.zh: 我们一起听外面的水声。
lines.en: Together we listen to the water outside.
She shifts, and the shell clicks softly.

lines.zh: 我们小得能共用一片影子。
lines.en: We are small enough to share one shadow.
I touch her forehead with my snout.
She swims out first; I follow.

lines.zh: 有危险，我把她推回壳里。
lines.en: At danger I push her back into the shell.
A tiny morsel falls into the shell mouth.
I hold it in my mouth without swallowing.
Whatever sinks, I quietly collect.

lines.zh: 这么小的食物也要抢吗？
lines.en: Must we fight over food this small?
I nudge it into the corner with my snout.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的，我都记得位置。
lines.en: I remember where every fallen scrap landed.

lines.zh: 我藏起食物，免得被看见。
lines.en: I hide the food so it is not seen.

lines.zh: 一口吞下，肚子还是空的。
lines.en: I swallow it; my belly is still empty.
This piece is bigger than me; I cannot move it.
I carry it in my teeth back into the dark.
A crumb is sinking; I have my eye on it.
That dark gap is where I want to go.
First my escape, then the food.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近壳口，我盯着。
lines.en: Something nears the shell; I watch it.
That crack is just wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我锁定一片落下的阴影。
lines.en: I fix on a falling shadow.

lines.zh: 那根水草下有安全的地方。
lines.en: Under that weed there is safety.

lines.zh: 我看见鲨鱼的尾巴转过弯。
lines.en: I see the shark's tail swing around the bend.
The target is small, but worth the risk.
I inch half a length toward it.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块碎屑不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at the crumb without blinking.
It sinks slowly; I wait.
I hug the shell mouth, ready to retreat.
The moment it stops, I dart out.
One inch away; I check three times.
I open my mouth and bite first.
It drifts off course; I turn after it.
I will not rush; rushing exposes me.
I count to three, then move.
I miss the bite and retreat at once.
I bite it once, like a mosquito sting.

lines.zh: 全力撞上去，也就推歪一点。
lines.en: I ram with all my weight and barely nudge it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，死不松口。
lines.en: I clamp its fin and refuse to let go.

lines.zh: 这一口只留下一个小点。
lines.en: This bite leaves only a tiny dot.
It shakes; I fly off and hit a shell.
My fighting is ugly, but I do not back off.
I bite it while trembling myself.
With three hearts, I cannot afford a trade.
I bite, then vanish into the crack.
Do not underestimate me; my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，我就出现了。
lines.en: The spawn egg clicks, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我没有故乡，只有这一次。
lines.en: I have no homeland, only this moment.
I wake in water and look for a shell.
I drop out of the light into the dark.
This place is strange; hide first.

lines.zh: 我是被放进来的，不是生来的。
lines.en: I was placed here, not born.
The space is huge; I shrink to a bead.
First task: find a gap to enter.

lines.zh: 有人放我下来，然后走了。
lines.en: Someone set me down and walked off.
I hug the bottom and learn the water.
Even the water is hot; my scales pull tight.
I fall out of the water onto hard sand.
Out of water, my mouth opens and closes.
The blast shatters the shell to pieces.

lines.zh: 什么东西穿过水扎进我身体。
lines.en: Something cuts the water and pierces me.
Cold light crawls into my bones.
Every crumb is gone; I am starving.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整只麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and numbs me whole.
Below is no water, only black.
